title: Digital UV Sterilisation Cabinet
summary: The Thistle Scientific digital UV Sterilisation Cabinets provide a convenient and controlled workspace for the preparation of PCR reactions in a nucleic acid–free environment, thereby significantly reducing the risk of PCR contamination. Acting as a cost-effective alternative to a clean room, the cabinets are equipped with high-intensity UV lamps capable of denaturing nucleic acids within 5 to 30 minutes, rendering them unsuitable for amplification. Integrated white lighting ensures excellent visibility during routine laboratory procedures.
overviewHtml:
The Thistle Scientific digital UV Sterilisation Cabinets provide a convenient and controlled workspace for the preparation of PCR reactions in a nucleic acid–free environment, thereby significantly reducing the risk of PCR contamination. Acting as a cost-effective alternative to a clean room, the cabinets are equipped with high-intensity UV lamps capable of denaturing nucleic acids within 5 to 30 minutes, rendering them unsuitable for amplification. Integrated white lighting ensures excellent visibility during routine laboratory procedures.

The main body is manufactured from a powder-coated metal structure with toughened glass front panels, providing resistance to a wide range of commonly used laboratory chemicals while maintaining clear visibility of the working area.

The UV lamps are controlled via an integrated digital timer, allowing precise and reproducible sterilisation cycles. In addition, safety interlock switches on the cabinet doors automatically deactivate the UV lights when the doors are opened, ensuring safe operation during routine use.

With benefits comparable to the standard DUVCAB, the Mini/Midi model is ideal for space- and budget-constrained laboratories. Its compact design allows it to fit neatly into smaller lab areas without compromising decontamination performance.


For use with trays of size 68 x 54cm, CSR-TW4/TY4/TL4.

Note: All DUVCAB models, regardless of size, operate with the same functions.

overviewHtml:
The Mini Incubator is designed for personal use and small laboratories. The unit features a broad temperature range to meet a variety of microbiology or haematology applications. It is compact and economical, featuring unique features. The housing is all corrosion-resistant metal. The glass window of the door offers full visibility to the interior. One stainless steel shelf is included, and can be adjusted to two different levels - additional shelves can be purchased to increase storage capacity. The colourful touch panel presents a vivid and intuitive user interface and the backlit LED ensures enough brightness even in dark environments.

The heating structure incorporated in the Mini Incubator performs even heating and precise temperature control. The microprocessor ensures temperature stability within the chamber. A thermometer port on the top of the unit allows users to monitor temperatures.

In addition, a designed spare port is on the rear of the chamber which allows an electrical cord to be routed out if needed

title: EZEEcycler TRI, Triple Block Thermal Cycler
overviewHtml:
Push the limits of PCR performance with EZEECYCLER-TRI, the most powerful high-throughput thermal cycler in its class. Run three independent experiments simultaneously (3×48samples) and experience unmatched flexibility. Smart gradient optimization and advanced ramp rate control deliver perfectly tuned PCR conditions, helping you achieve faster, more efficient results. KEY FEATURES:

Triple-Block Flexibility

Run three separate PCR programs simultaneously, making it ideal for shared labs and experiments requiring varied conditions.

High-Throughput Efficiency

Boost productivity with capacity for up to 3 x 48 wells, accommodating 0.1- or0.2-ml sample volumes.

Fast Gradient Optimization

Easily fine-tune PCR settings across three independent blocks, with temperature ranges from 30 °C to 100 °C and a maximum gradient span of 30 °C.

Advanced Ramp Rate Control

Modify ramp speeds between 0.1 and 5.0°C per second to support a wide range of assays, including those used in CRISPR applications.

Intuitive Operation

Easily program experiments using a large 10.1-inch colour touchscreen designed for simple, user-friendly navigation.

Continuous Reliability: Zero Downtime

Each of the three independent block modules can be individually calibrated, allowing maintenance without interrupting system operation.

title: TOUCH SCREEN POWER Pro 300V 700mA 150W – 110/230V
summary: The PowerPro300-M2 touch screen power supply is a versatile, multi-functional unit designed for a wide range of electrophoresis applications and is among the most advanced power supplies available on the market featuring advanced functionality, including a 4.3″ color touchscreen.
overviewHtml:
The PowerPro300-M2 touch screen power supply is a versatile, multi-functional unit designed for a wide range of electrophoresis applications and is among the most advanced power supplies available on the market featuring advanced functionality, including a 4.3″ color touchscreen. 

At 300V, 700mA, and 150W, the PowerPro300-M2 delivers nearly twice the current and power of the market-leading equivalent unit. It is perfectly suited for use with Cleaver Scientific’s multiSUB range of horizontal electrophoresis systems and omniPAGE Mini vertical electrophoresis systems.

The PowerPro300-M2 features built-in pre-set protocols for running each of Cleaver Scientific’s electrophoresis systems and allows users to create and save protocols for their own systems with the ability to export the last run report through a USB port.

A touch screen displays current running parameters and enables easy browsing of pre-set and saved protocols.

The PowerPro300-M2 can be operated at constant voltage, constant current, or constant power and can store up to 100 programmes with up to 30 steps each. A convenient pause/resume function allows any run to be temporarily halted for gel inspection and restarted from the same position.

The PowerPro300-M2 touch screen power supply is the ideal choice for:

  • Routine horizontal electrophoresis using multiSUB Mini, Midi, and Choice
  • Vertical electrophoresis using omniPAGE Mini

Note: The touch screen display shown is for illustration purposes only. Screen layout, displayed parameters, and available functions may vary depending on the specific power supply model, voltage range, and product configuration.

title: VORTEXM2
summary: The Cleaver Scientific Vortex Mixer is an efficient and compact instrument for any routine mixing applications needed in the field of life sciences, chemistry, medicine, bioengineering, analytical and research laboratories.
overviewHtml:
The Cleaver Scientific Vortex Mixer is an efficient and compact instrument for any routine mixing applications needed in the field of life sciences, chemistry, medicine, bioengineering, analytical and research laboratories.

This product includes the eccentric rotating structure to generate vortex flow in the liquid in test tubes, centrifuge tubes, microplates and other containers and offers full mixing of the solution.

Choose from two modes of operation: continuous mode provides a variable speed and can allow low rpm start-up for gentle mixing or high speed mixing for vigorous vortexing of samples, and touch mode which activates mixing when depressing the platform.

Our Vortex Mixer is stable and reliable with reliable durability and a variety of accessories to choose from to adapt to different experimental needs.

title: EZEEcycler PRO, Precision Thermal Cycler
overviewHtml:
The EZEEcycler PRO thermal cycler is engineered to maximize PCR efficiency and precision. Featuring a responsive 7” touchscreen and an intuitive graphical interface, it ensures easy and seamless operation. Its adjustable ramp rates and gradient temperature control provide enhanced flexibility for precise PCR optimization. KEY FEATURES:
  • Flexible Ramp Rate Control – Adjust from 0.1 to 5.5 °C/sec to suit the requirements of diverse experiments.
  • Fully Adjustable Lid Temperature – Set between 35 °C and 120 °C to accommodate virtually any experiment, including NGS pre-treatment.
  • Gradient Optimization – A 1–30 °C range allows precise optimization of experimental conditions in a single PCR run.
  • Effortless Control – The responsive 7” capacitive touchscreen ensures smooth operation, even while wearing laboratory gloves.
  • Intuitive Interface – A user-friendly graphical interface allows quick and easy adjustment of experiment parameters, including temperature, time, and cycles.
  • Large Program Storage – Holds over 4,000 built-in protocols and features a USB port for easy transfer of additional programs.

summary: At 300V, 3000mA, 300W, the PowerPro 3AMP-M2 touch screen power supply is designed for virtually all high-current electrophoresis applications. overviewHtml:
At 300V, 3000mA, 300W, the PowerPro 3AMP-M2 touch screen power supply is designed for virtually all high-current electrophoresis applications. The PowerPro 3AMP’s higher current output capability is perfect for electroblotting units with high-intensity plate electrodes, particularly Cleaver Scientific omniBLOT maxi, VS20 WAVE, and semi-dry blotting systems.

Electrotransfers may be performed as timed runs in constant or programmable mode via an intuitive touch screen interface to prevent overheating and buffer depletion. A run time extendable to a maximum of 999 minutes in constant mode is also useful for overnight transfers undertaken at constant low current in wire electrode systems.

The PowerPro 3AMP-M2 features a touch screen display and shares the built-in protocol and constant parameter features of the other PowerPro models. PowerPro 3AMP-M2 is the ideal power supply for:

  • Vertical electrophoresis using omniPAGE Maxi
  • Blotting using omniBLOT and semi-dry blotters

overviewHtml:
With a maximum 500V, 800mA and 300W voltage, current, and power output, the PowerPro 500-M2 touch screen power supply is an excellent general-purpose unit that fits the broadest range of electrophoresis applications and featuring advanced functionality, including a 4.3″ color touchscreen. It can run as many as four units under constant or programmable settings with a capacity to store up to 100 programmes with up to 30 steps each, making the PowerPro 500-M2 ideal for techniques that benefit from subtle and gradual stepwise changes in electrical parameters as the run progresses, such as DGGE and large-format vertical PAGE using Cleaver Scientific VS20-DGGE and WAVE systems.

The PowerPro 500-M2 features built-in pre-set protocols for each of Cleaver Scientific’s electrophoresis systems and allows users to create and save protocols for their own systems. A touch screen displays current running parameters and enables easy navigation of pre-set and saved protocols. The PowerPro 500-M2 can be operated at constant voltage, constant current, or constant power. A convenient pause/resume function allows any run to be temporarily halted for gel inspection and restarted from the same position.

The PowerPro 500 touch screen power supply is the ideal choice for:

  • Routine horizontal electrophoresis using multiSUB Mini, Midi, and Choice
  • Vertical electrophoresis using omniPAGE Mini
  • Cleaver Scientific DGGE
  • Vertical electrophoresis using omniPAGE Maxi
